description: This PHP source file defines the UserRoleManagerHelper class, which provides helper methods for managing and retrieving user role permissions and data group permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with internal services and data transfer objects to facilitate permission checks and retrievals related to employees and data groups.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to handle user role permissions, data group permissions, and entity access checks within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Retrieves the user role manager service from the container, returning an instance of AbstractUserRoleManager or BasicUserRoleManager.

methods.name: getEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Returns resource permissions for given data groups without considering employee or other entity context.

methods.name: geEntityIndependentDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions for specified data groups without employee/entity context.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves data group permissions for a specific employee, considering self-permissions if the employee is the logged-in user.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Returns a collection of data group permissions for a specified employee.

methods.name: isSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks if the provided employee number matches the logged-in user's employee number.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Determines if an employee is accessible either via entity access or if it is the logged-in user.
